```{r}
#   James
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
###CT_stops <- read_csv("data/CT_stops.csv")
###CT_prediction_set <- read_csv("data/CT_prediction_set.csv")
search_rate_by <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na({{ var }}), !is.na(contraband_found)) %>%
    group_by({{ var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stops     = n(),
      n_contraband  = sum(contraband_found),
      contraband_proportion = mean(contraband_found),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(contraband_proportion))
}

searched <- CT_stops %>% filter(contraband_found)

 
#county_names vs search conducted
county_search <- CT_stops %>%
  filter(!is.na(county_name), !is.na(contraband_found)) %>%
  group_by(county_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_stops     = n(),
    n_contraband  = sum(contraband_found),
    contraband_proportion = mean(contraband_found)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(contraband_proportion))

county_search

chisq.test(CT_stops$county_name, CT_stops$contraband_found)

#driver_gender vs search conducted

gender_search <- search_rate_by(CT_stops, driver_gender)
gender_search


#driver_age vs search conducted

age_search <- CT_stops %>%
  filter(!is.na(driver_age), !is.na(contraband_found)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = cut(driver_age,
                         breaks = c(15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100),
                         right = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n_stops = n(),
            search_rate = mean(contraband_found))

age_search

#driver_race vs search conducted

race_search <- search_rate_by(CT_stops, driver_race)
race_search

chisq.test(CT_stops$driver_race, CT_stops$contraband_found)

#violation vs search conducted

violation_search <- search_rate_by(CT_stops, violation)
violation_search

chisq.test(CT_stops$violation, CT_stops$contraband_found)

#Check these variables against on if contraband was found
```
